children: ANNOUNCES LONG-TERM STRATEGIC COLLABORATION WITH AMAZON
HAS ENTERED INTO A LONG-TERM STRATEGIC COLLABORATION WITH ITS CUSTOMER, AMAZON
COLLABORATION IS COMPREHENSIVE IN ITS SCOPE

COLLABORATION IS SUPPORTED BY A CALL OPTION ON EXISTING KUEHNE+NAGEL SHARES THAT SETTLES IN CASH OR, AT AMAZON'S ELECTION, IN SHARES, WITH VESTING BASED ON COMMERCIAL MILESTONES AND SERVICES OVER A PERIOD OF UP TO SEVEN YEARS
KUEHNE+NAGEL HAS ARRANGED FOR A THIRD-PARTY FINANCIAL INSTITUTION TO ENGAGE IN HEDGING TRANSACTIONS IN KUEHNE+NAGEL SHARES TO SUPPORT THIS ARRANGEMENT
